title: verifyValidator() is callable by anyone — no access control — allows unauthorized state transitions
claimed_impact: Any attacker can supply a cryptographically valid beacon proof to transition a STAKED validator to INVALID, removing its deposit from depositList and reducing lastVerifiedEthBalance (impacting checkBalance). This causes the strategy to under-report its assets to the vault, potentially triggering incorrect rebalancing or allowing the vault to allocate more funds than it should. Additionally, resetting firstDeposit to false at the wrong time creates a window for front-run deposit attacks on the next deposit cycle.
